A backup stores all conversations of the: A backup stores all conversations of the agent (the store session.sqlite, compressed) together with the assignment of the messenger chats as a file in the storage folder pi-agent.0.storage/backups. You find it in the admin under Files, where it can be downloaded and uploaded; ioBroker and BackItUp backups take it along. Restore replaces the conversations by the chosen backup and restarts the instance; the current conversations are saved first as a safety copy.
The conversations of the agent are repla: The conversations of the agent are replaced by the chosen backup and the instance restarts. The current conversations are saved first as a safety copy. Continue?
Saves a backup of the conversations at t: Saves a backup of the conversations at the chosen interval as a new file in the storage folder. The interval counts from the last backup, also after a restart; a backup that is due runs five minutes after the start.
Every backup (by hand and automatic) is: Every backup (by hand and automatic) is also copied to another computer over SFTP, for example a NAS, so it survives the loss of this host. Use a user that may only write into the target directory, not an administrator. The copy needs no mount and no sudo. The file contains the full text of the conversations and the values the agent read, and it is not encrypted on the server: keep it on a volume only you can read.
e.g. /backups/pi-agent, created when it: e.g. /backups/pi-agent, created when it is missing
After a new installation of ioBroker: en: After a new installation of ioBroker: enter the SFTP settings above, switch the copy on and save. Then choose a backup on the server and restore it. The file is fetched into the storage folder and the conversations are replaced; the current conversations are saved first as a safety copy.
The conversations of the agent are repla: The conversations of the agent are replaced by the chosen backup from the server and the instance restarts. The current conversations are saved first as a safety copy. Continue?
No API key entered: the system-wide AI s: No API key entered: the system-wide AI settings of admin (System settings, tab "AI") are used.
One row per scope: an instance (hm-rpc.0: One row per scope: an instance (hm-rpc.0) or an object ID with everything below it, or a pattern with * (hm-rpc.0.*.STATE). States that match no row can only be read. "Confirmation required" counts only where writing is allowed. "Restart allowed" counts only for a whole instance (not pi-agent or admin); every restart is confirmed in the chat.
Protects against loops: a script or anot: Protects against loops: a script or another adapter that asks again right after every answer. Further requests of the same conversation (messenger chat, user of the admin chat, satellite, sendTo conversation, job) are refused without asking the model. 0 = no limit.
When the tokens of the day (from midnigh: When the tokens of the day (from midnight in the time zone of the house, state usage.tokensToday) reach this number, the agent stops asking the model until midnight and answers every request with a note; usage.limitReached is then true. 0 = no limit.
Code mode: scripts for questions about m: Code mode: scripts for questions about many states
For a question about many states (all ba: For a question about many states (all batteries, every room) the agent writes a short script that calls its tools in a sandbox, and only the result goes to the model: faster and fewer tokens. Write permissions, simulation mode and confirmations count for every call of the script. It saves tokens only on questions with several steps (combine data, count, go through many devices); a simple question costs a little more than without it. Works best with strong models.
The agent keeps facts you tell it to rem: The agent keeps facts you tell it to remember (tools remember and forget) across all conversations, in the state memory.list
The agent may update adapters with an in: The agent may update adapters with an instance that has "Write allowed" (and itself), never admin or js-controller; every update is confirmed in the chat
Confirmation by text in sendTo conversat: Confirmation by text in sendTo conversations
For callers with a conversation of their: For callers with a conversation of their own, e.g. ioBroker.assistant: the question is the answer, the next message decides. Only a plain "yes" confirms; anything else or 2 minutes of silence is no. By voice anyone in the room can say yes.
Voice messages to the bots with \"Voice\: Voice messages to the bots with "Voice" ticked are turned into text and answered like a written message; the recognized text is shown in the chat first. The prefix does not apply to them. Own server: any server with the transcription API of OpenAI, for example speaches (faster-whisper) in Docker, usually without a key. OpenRouter: its speech models; without a key here the OpenRouter key of the agent or of the system settings of admin (tab "AI") is used. Telegram and MAX (adapter max 0.1.13 or newer) deliver voice messages.

Choose from the list or type a model ID. Empty: openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo with OpenRouter; a server needs one of its models
Two letters, for example de or ru. Empty: Two letters, for example de or ru. Empty: detected for every message (a local server then needs longer)
Photos: photos sent to the bot go to the: Photos: photos sent to the bot go to the model with their caption, the photos of an album as one question (at most 4). A text sent right after photos without caption is their question. The model sees a photo only once and keeps notes of it for later questions. Telegram saves photos only with "Save files" in its settings; set "Delete received files after (days)" there (telegram 6.3.0+) so old ones are removed. MAX saves them always.
